relationships.john-quedolan: Team leader whose puppeteered lance kills him.

periods.summary: Reed is a large, barrel-built Quedolan representative who trains his magic release strength on a pressure machine before the war. He is newly married to Ainalise and is teased by teammates about family life. When Or-Gaule invades the training facility, John is puppeteered and abruptly impales Reed through the heart, making Reed the first casualty of the massacre.

key_events.summary: Is killed by John's lance as Or-Gaule begins the slaughter.
